  echo: false
---

```{python}
import json
import pandas as pd
S = json.load(open("outputs/summary.json"))
prof = pd.read_csv("outputs/cluster_profiles.csv").set_index("cluster")
```

K-means on nine profile features (utility-supplied IRCA, coverage, poverty, rurality,
altitude, rainfall, performance, water transfers) finds **`{python} S['k']` kinds** of
municipal zone among `{python} f"{S['kept']:,}"` municipality-zone-year rows, 2016-2023:

```{python}
from IPython.display import Markdown
Markdown("\n".join(f"- {r['name']} (median IRCA {r['irca_median']}, {r['municipalities']} municipalities)" for _, r in prof.iterrows()))
```

Outcomes (infant mortality, Saber 11, dropout) did not enter the clustering. They differ
across clusters, but this is descriptive and does not establish a causal effect of water
quality. Details: [clusters](../clusters.qmd) and the [report](../report.qmd).
